dataClasses.title: Where our data comes from
dataClasses.legend: Every number on this page carries its data class:
dataClasses.OFFERMARKT_DESC: Computed from verified offers submitted on Offermarket.
dataClasses.OFFICIAL_DESC: CBS, UWV, RVO, Dutch government, Eurostat, European Commission — always linked to the original source.
dataClasses.THIRD_PARTY_DESC: Third-party research, summarized and attributed — never republished.
dataClasses.EDITORIAL_DESC: Our own analysis. Makes no data claims.

marketValue.title: Market value indicator
marketValue.subtitle: A transparent points score based on your profile and live market data
marketValue.noBlackBox: No hidden model: every point comes from the rule shown above, computed from your own profile and marketplace aggregates.
marketValue.salaryPercentile: Your desired salary sits at the {percentile}th percentile of comparable offers.
marketValue.experienceBand: Based on your own {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} of experience — worth {points} of 25 points.
marketValue.experienceUnknown: No experience filled in yet, so this component scores 0 — add it on your profile.
marketValue.skillsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No profile skills listed yet} other {# listed skill(s), 5 points each}} — worth {points} of 25 points.
marketValue.certsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No certifications} other {# certification(s), 7.5 points each}} — worth {points} of 15 points.
marketValue.certsNone: No certifications listed, so this component scores 0.
marketValue.demandVeryHigh: Very high demand for your trade right now ({offers} offers in the window) — full 20 points.
marketValue.demandHigh: High demand for your trade right now ({offers} offers in the window) — 15 points.
marketValue.demandModerate: Moderate demand for your trade ({offers} offers in the window) — 10 points.
marketValue.demandLow: Some demand for your trade ({offers} offers in the window) — 5 points.
marketValue.demandUnknown: Not enough marketplace data yet to assess demand for your trade — this component scores 0 and says so.
marketValue.offersCount: Employers sent {count} offer(s) in the last window — 3 points each, capped at 15.
marketValue.offersNone: No offers received in this window yet, so this component scores 0.
